result: Keeping SPIDER’s recursive gradient estimator but taking constant steps η = 1/(2L) keeps the near-optimal O(√n ε^{−2} + n) stochastic-gradient complexity for ε-stationary points, runs much faster in practice, and extends to proximal (nonsmooth regularized) and momentum variants.
result_plain: SpiderBoost: SPIDER estimator with a large constant step; O(√n/ε² + n), with prox and momentum versions.
